items.before: The five question labels on arrival details are now medium size. The port of entry hint reads 'Select where the transporter will enter with the consignment. Start typing to search by port or airport name or code.', and the empty box shows 'Select a port'. The means of transport options read Air, Rail, Road and Sea, and the transport identification hint starts 'Enter one of the following:'. What is stored does not change. Plants' arrival details labels are also medium size, and its place of landing hint follows the same pattern.
items.after:
The five question labels on arrival details are now medium size.

Other wording on arrival details:

- The port of entry hint reads 'Select where the transporter will enter with the consignment. Start typing to search by port or airport name or code.'
- The empty port of entry box shows 'Select a port'.
- The means of transport options read Air, Rail, Road and Sea.
- The transport identification hint starts 'Enter one of the following:'.

What is stored does not change.

In plants:

- Arrival details labels are also medium size.
- The place of landing hint follows the same pattern.

items.before: Each port in the port of entry search, and in plants' place of landing search, now reads as its name, a dash and its code. The chosen port shows the same way in the box. Without JavaScript it is still a dropdown. The separate Search button the prototype shows waits on design.
items.after:
Each port now reads as its name, a dash and its code. This applies to:

- the port of entry search
- plants' place of landing search

The chosen port shows the same way in the box.

Without JavaScript, it is still a dropdown.

The prototype shows a separate Search button. That button is waiting on design.

items.before: Before, 'Save and continue' on live-animals arrival details needed every answer. Now only the means of transport is required, because it decides whether transit countries are asked; leaving it blank shows 'Select a means of transport to the port of entry'. The other answers can be left for later, though any answer given still has to be in the right format. Plants' arrival details keeps its own rules.
items.after:
Before, 'Save and continue' on live-animals arrival details needed every answer.

Now only the means of transport is required. This is because it decides whether transit countries are asked.

Leaving it blank shows 'Select a means of transport to the port of entry'.

The other answers can be left for later. But any answer given still has to be in the right format.

Plants' arrival details keeps its own rules.

items.before: The browser title now reads 'Transit countries'. Reached from arrival details, Back goes to arrival details; opened from the overview, Back goes to the overview. With no countries added, the page no longer shows an empty list or 'You have not added any countries yet.' Opening the page when the means of transport is Air or Sea, or not given, goes to the overview.
items.after:
The browser title now reads 'Transit countries'.

Where Back goes depends on how the page was reached:

- from arrival details, Back goes to arrival details
- from the overview, Back goes to the overview

With no countries added, the page no longer shows:

- an empty list
- 'You have not added any countries yet.'

Opening the page goes to the overview when the means of transport is:

- Air
- Sea
- not given
